sharing.burnedInNote: De-identification removes the name, IDs, birth date, hospital and staff from every file, and keeps age, sex and dates. Text burned into the picture itself — common on ultrasound, screen captures and photographed films — can’t be removed: check those images before sending.

sharing.pinNote: PIN {{pin}} — give it to the doctor separately (a call, not the same message). It is not shown again.
sharing.anonRemoved: Patient identity removed — the doctor sees an anonymised study with age and sex only.
sharing.worksUntil: Works until {{when}}. This is the only time the full link is shown — copy it now, or revoke it below and make a new one.
sharing.revokeMessage: {{name}} will no longer be able to open the images.
sharing.revokeMessageDoctor: The doctor will no longer be able to open the images.
sharing.introAnon: The doctor sees the images read-only (and the signed report, if you include it) as an anonymised study — age and sex only, no name, UHID or hospital IDs in the files.
sharing.introNamed: The doctor sees the images read-only (and the signed report, if you include it), with {{name}}’s name, age and sex — nothing else from the hospital’s records.
sharing.introPatient: The doctor sees the images read-only (and the signed report, if you include it), with the patient’s name, age and sex — nothing else from the hospital’s records.
sharing.pinHintOn: Give the PIN separately. 5 wrong tries lock the link for a while.
sharing.pinHintOff: Optional — the doctor must enter it to open the link.
